<h1 className={"openapi__heading"}>Update a metrics account soft limit</h1>

<MethodEndpoint method={"put"} path={"/v1/account-management/metrics-accounts/{metricsAccountId}/soft-limit"}></MethodEndpoint>



Sets the soft limit of a **Consumption** metrics account.

The soft limit caps the number of unique time series (UTS) the metrics account is allowed to ingest. It takes effect only when it is greater than the account's plan UTS: a lower or equal value, including `0`, is stored but ignored, and the account is then limited by its plan instead.

A soft limit cannot be removed once set - there is no way to set it back to null.

The soft limits of all metrics accounts of the owner account together must not exceed the owner account's metrics budget, otherwise the request returns `400`.

Available for **Consumption** accounts only. If the account is not a Consumption account, the request returns `400`.

Please ensure to change the region in the URL to match your account's region.
